title: One Token, Many Lessons: Sliding-Window Attention within Gated Delta Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.33257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear attention compresses historical context into a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing the computational and memory costs of long-sequence modeling. From the perspective of test-time regression (TTR), the state matrix can be viewed as an online-learned regression model, where keys and values serve as inputs and targets respectively, and queries are used to read from the model. From this perspective, the effectiveness of state learning depends not only on the update rule but also on how the key-value learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. While existing work has largely focused on how the state is updated and organized, we investigate how the learning pairs used for state updates are constructed. To this end, we propose Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet (SWGDN), which replaces short convolutions in Delta-Rule linear attention with sliding-window attention to perform content-dependent local aggregation of projected querie

translated_title: 一个Token，多重教训：门控Delta网络中的滑窗注意力
translated_abstract: 线性注意力将历史上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态，从而降低了长序列建模的计算与内存开销。从测试时回归（TTR）的视角来看，状态矩阵可以被视为一个在线学习的回归模型，其中键和值分别充当输入和目标，而查询则用于从该模型中读取信息。基于这一视角，状态学习的有效性不仅取决于更新规则，还取决于用于状态更新的键值学习对是如何构建的。虽然现有工作大多聚焦于状态如何被更新与组织，我们则研究了用于状态更新的学习对是如何构建的。为此，我们提出了滑窗门控DeltaNet（SWGDN），用滑窗注意力取代Delta规则线性注意力中的短卷积，以对投影后的查询进行内容依赖的局部聚合……
tldr: 提出滑窗门控DeltaNet（SWGDN），从测试时回归视角研究状态更新中键值学习对的构建方式，用滑窗注意力替代短卷积实现内容依赖的局部查询聚合，以提升线性注意力的状态学习效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet (SWGDN), which investigates how key-value learning pairs for state updates are constructed from a test-time regression perspective, replacing short convolutions with sliding-window attention to perform content-dependent local aggregation of queries for better state learning in linear attention.
